supplements.label: Lived experience
supplements.prompt: Diversity of all kinds is important to enriching the educational experience at Howard University. Please share with us anything in your background or lived experience that has shaped your perspectives and how that would contribute to the classroom and community at Howard.

supplements.label: Intended major
